previous_reply_acts.text:
(what I checked) codex-15's commits are futon0 `06d2743` and futon3c `38611194`. My review found two problems, which I fixed:
1. **"commit" and "usage" were still tagging.** Codex counted a collision only when the same exact string appeared under two nodes. Now every cue an elaborating agent named as a collision is excluded too, which brings the vocabulary to 353 cues. A new test checks that "commit" and "usage" are gone. futon0 `cc23d7a`; the tests pass.
2. **Typing could have lagged.** On every jit-lock call, which means every keystroke, the painter rescanned all your turns in the buffer with all 353 patterns. Now it repaints only the turns that overlap the part being redrawn, and still repaints each of those turns whole, so a cue spanning a boundary isn't missed. futon3c `dad8f7ba`.

previous_reply_acts.text: (what to expect) These are draft tags from a word list, marked provisional in the hover text. Some will be wrong. If a tag looks wrong, tell me the word and the node, and I'll keep those as corrections for the 象 step.
